notes.title: Check out our other titles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/5fc1cd291aae91848521cfa559a84a23258c42a6.png[/img]
Hello card-slinging zombie killers!
If you enjoy the CARDS GUNS ZOMBIES Demo check out our other games. They touch on different topics and everyone should be able to find something interesting. 

[h2]Alchemist: The Potion Monger[/h2]
First-person Alchemist Simulator with RPG elements. Explore the world, gather ingredients, and sell or use potions you craft to help others and fend off enemies. Adopt pets to help you with your alchemy knowledge (and to pet them). Decorate your home however you like and brew your destiny!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094370/Alchemist_The_Potion_Monger/

[h2]WW2: Bunker Simulator[/h2]
During WWII you are an American soldier who captured the German bunker in Normandy. You must defend it at all costs and survive this World War II. Complete missions, cook & shoot, and search the bodies for medicines, ammo, and food to survive. WW2: Bunker Simulator is a mix of fps and simulator.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1155870/WW2_Bunker_Simulator/

[h2]Climber: Sky is the Limit[/h2]
Climber: Sky is the Limit is a mountain walking simulator game where you become a winter climber. To succeed you need to plan the trip, prepare appropriate equipment, face extreme weather conditions, and survive. Only the sky is the limit!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231840/Climber_Sky_is_the_Limit/

notes.title: Devlog#2 - ZOMBIES
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/6553c1e0b6bc7b4ee59c8d1d62a1ab4695bc02a8.png[/img]
Hello soon-to-be zombie-slaying experts!
Let's address the zombies in the room - [b]ZOMBIES[/b]
They come in various shapes and forms but are all stinky, flesh-hungry, and deserve to - [b]DIE[/b]

Let's have a quick run-up on some of the [b]ZOMBIES[/b] types:
[h3]Normies[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/f20fdc4b68c701ea72a52d6b22ca36f3237e5e97.jpg[/img]
Your go-to zombies. Not so smart not so fast and not so tough.
They come in two variants: [b]white[/b] - weaker, and [b]black[/b] - stronger.

[h3]Oldies[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/18d28cefac7d1ae4a8a6a89c9717565b67c36829.jpg[/img]
An older generation of zombies, as they had their years when they turned. 
Because of their old bones, they are slow and die really quickly when shown respect with lead/steel.

[h3]Goths[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/b9d2c6004f086530da6d6be9357658b5ce7df40b.jpg[/img]
The fastest zombie subculture, the undead zombie girls run fast to get you, but luckily they are not so tough and are easy to put down.

[h3]Biggies[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/b9648e8b5c31f5b2bf40c862cd675b2f84afe818.jpg[/img]
Most likely former life bodyguards. Big, strong, ultimate bullet sponges. Not so fast, but don't let them get to you.

[h3]Double Infected[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/e171507a95c1168a9da44661f68ea605ae44f8bb.jpg[/img]
Zombies bitten by other zombies turn into DOUBLE ZOMBIES! Fast and furious, move on all 4 jumping on the victims. Find and kill them for bonus cash!

These are only the beginning there are a lot more to come!
You'll encounter all of them in the upcoming DEMO.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181330/CARDS_GUNS_ZOMBIES_Demo/


If you have any questions regarding the game, want to see some sneak peeks, or simply want to chat
[url=https://discord.gg/7WhBHwkET3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/abf8056fd0a40a0dda17f578fea517576d8e032b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog#1 - CARDS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/2aa5ae39790cf357af3ed65be8d34071b6f68d04.png[/img]
Hello, forthcoming zombie eradicators!
In our first Devlog, we tackle the topic of one of the 3 most important things in CARDS GUNS ZOMBIES.
[h1]CARDS[/h1]
After each successful game, you can buy packs of cards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/8e29e31c938e521550a0a39d071901b111748121.jpg[/img]
and/or singles from the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/d1e2439f6320e81b9ffb2dfb1e4f492854ae063c.jpg[/img]
[h2]Cards types, examples, and how they change your game:[/h2]
[h3]Passive[/h3]
Working from start to finish, changing your game and your score multiplier.
[b]Example: Survivor Hunter[/b] - Normally you get $ for rescuing citizens, this changes your contract to kill them (before zombies do).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/37fec32234ffff221fb2dbbabe0ccd804153a40a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Active[/h3]
In the palm of your virtual hand accessible with the press of a button.
[b]Example: Simple White Truck[/b] - Summon a truck (on cooldown) that honks, attracting the zombies' attention, and then runs them over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/a03c482eb2461576c4afc5af4ba7219d4d46dfa9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
From simple pistols, and sniper rifles to knives, bats, and katanas.
[b]Example: SPAS-12[/b] - Powerful close-quarter weapon, shooting heavy pellets, if it doesn't kill outright, it will surely knock down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/a8566977950caa9ea4b6dbd08fb136df7328cedf.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rarities:[/h2]
Cards come in 4 rarities: [b]Common [/b](gray), [b]Rare [/b](blue), [b]Epic [/b](purple), and [b]LEGENDARY [/b](gold).
[h2]Loadout:[/h2]
Before every game you'll use cards you own to create a Loadout - a set of cards you take to the action.
Grab your best cards or create combos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138667/8655ea64f1d61bcb523a7265db8413c8612fcbc0.jpg[/img]

that's all for now, [b]we got a game to make![/b]
more info coming soon
AGS Team
